Never read fixture.txt yourself: only the assigned child may inspect it. Do not invent a nonce, run ID, child result, tool call, or supervisor request. Use only returned real IDs/references. You may read an actual child result file reference returned by a tool if its content is not inline. Do not create or change files. Finish with the exact nonce obtained from the child's actual result, not just a launch acknowledgment. Every public subagent launch must use output as string "false" and options {"acceptance":false,"mission":false,"context":"fresh","timeoutMs":570000,"chatProgress":"off","sessionDir":"/private/var/folders/3t/klpc9c5d5l5fpkgynvj92ys00000gn/T/pi-gigachat-live-Og7rqt/supervisor/sessions"}; these controls belong in options, not extra top-level fields. Do not pass boolean workflow or output values. Launch agent live-decision with async:true; its task is to read ./fixture.txt, call contact_supervisor with reason need_decision and message "Which verification marker should I append?", wait for the actual reply, and report its nonce plus the chosen marker. After launch call bg_wait with the actual run ID, timeoutMs:570000 and stopOnAttention:true, so it returns when the real child needs a decision. Then call subagent_supervisor({"action":"pending"}) to obtain the exact pending request ID. You are authorized to answer exactly "Use VERIFIED". Call subagent_supervisor with all THREE fields {"action":"reply","replyTo":"<actual pending request ID>","message":"Use VERIFIED"}. Replace only the ID placeholder; do not omit the message field. An action/replyTo-only call is invalid. Do not guess an ID or steer a substitute answer. After the successful reply, call bg_wait again with the actual launched run ID and timeoutMs:570000, stopOnAttention:false. Obtain the actual finished child result and give its nonce plus VERIFIED in your final answer.

Available tools:
- read: Read file contents
- subagents_enable: pi-subagents is installed. For authorized specialist, independent-review, or parallel work, call subagents_enable, then subagent. Authorization must come from the current request or applicable instructions; complexity alone is not authorization.

In addition to the tools above, you may have access to other custom tools depending on the project.

- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
